audit.G1_note: Item asked for split compression with r sweep. Experiment implements exactly this: topk=512 + tail SVD at r={2,4,8,16}. Param matching impossible due to full c_fc requirement — honestly reported.
audit.G2_note: r=0 baseline reproduces topk+lstsq: unpolished 74.75, polished 59.39 (consistent with known ~70.7 unpolished, ~59 polished). Baseline PPL variance across seeds is high (seed 42: 57.7, seed 137: 48.8, seed 7: 50.4) but within expected GPT-2 range.
audit.G3_note: Item criteria: INCONCLUSIVE if within +/-2 PPL. Best delta is 0.97 polished, 0.55 unpolished. Both within +/-2. Correct verdict.
audit.G4_note: SVD computed on probe_train activations (4096 tokens), eval on separate eval_val (200 sequences). No overlap.
audit.G5_note: JSON results, PNG plot, experiment script all present.
audit.G6_note: Split uses 3.57x more params (2.81M vs 787K per block) due to full c_fc. This is inherent to the approach — you need all c_fc rows to compute tail activations. Honestly reported in results and verdict note.
